name: DataReviewPolicy
description: Manifest for `qctl apply -f`. Gates rows that land in quarantine: whether they require reviewer approval before release, how many reviewers, and whether approval releases them automatically. Omit spec.dataset_id for an org-level policy. See also: qctl guide data-review-policy.

properties.name: metadata
properties.description: Optional. metadata.name is a human label; metadata.id is set on round-tripped output.

properties.name: id
properties.description: Existing policy ID (present on `get -o yaml` output).

properties.name: dataset_id
properties.description: Target table (dataset) ID. Omit for an org-level policy that applies to every table.

properties.name: requires_review
properties.description: If true, rows landing in quarantine require reviewer approval before they can be released.

properties.name: auto_release_on_approval
properties.description: If true, a row whose data review is approved is released out of quarantine automatically; if false, release is a separate step. 'qctl rows release' ignores this setting: it records the caller's approval and releases a row only once it has enough approvals, skipping rows the caller edited or submitted for review.

properties.name: min_reviewers
properties.description: Minimum number of distinct eligible reviewers who must approve the row's current version before release. Anyone who submitted or ever edited the row, including undo and redo actors, is excluded.

properties.name: designated_reviewer_ids
properties.description: If set, only these reviewers' approvals count toward min_reviewers.
